summary: Rewrite history is rebuilt: drag commits to fold, squash or move them, and see what the branch becomes before you apply.

new.title: Rewrite history as two graphs
new.copy: The branch is drawn as it is Now, next to what it becomes After Apply, with a color for each kind of change.

new.title: Every rewrite is tried on a copy first
new.copy: Apply tries each change on a temporary copy and checks the result, and only then moves your branch.

new.title: Backups you can restore
new.copy: Every rewrite saves a backup first.

features.title: Welcome to Goodboy
features.copy: Go from install to a first agent reading your repo in a few short steps.

features.title: Provider connection
features.copy: Connect each provider the way it supports, with a login you already have or an API key.

features.title: One page per provider
features.copy: Find usage, the models in your picker, permissions and your account on one page per provider.

features.title: Update the provider CLI
features.copy: Find out when a model needs a newer CLI, and update it from the provider page once running turns finish.

features.title: Permissions for each provider
features.copy: See which permission modes a provider can honor before you pick one: Read only, Ask first, Edits allowed and Full access, each marked as working, partly working or not available, with the reason.

features.title: Workspace with several projects
features.copy: Keep your repos together as one workspace, and let one session work across several of them.

features.title: Starred projects, descriptions and base branch
features.copy: Point agents at the right repo without naming it.

features.title: Open in new window
features.copy: Give each workspace its own window, so switching does not interrupt running agents.

features.title: Locate moved projects
features.copy: Moved your repos to a new folder?

features.title: Workspace switcher and Reconnect
features.copy: Jump between workspaces and projects from one search.

features.title: Keep .goodboy out of git
features.copy: Keep Goodboy's own folder out of your commits with one click.

features.title: Repo status across projects
features.copy: See which repos are behind, uncommitted or diverged from the board's N repos popover, and update the safe ones together.

features.title: Integrations
features.copy: Connect GitHub, GitLab, Bitbucket, Linear, Jira, Sentry and Slack from one settings page, and give a project a different account than its workspace when you need to.

features.title: About you
features.copy: Tell agents once who you are and how you like to work, in four short parts.

features.title: How do you want to start?
features.copy: Start from an issue, a workflow or a question, in one draft with three tabs: Pick up a task, Run a workflow and Ask an agent.

features.title: Start blank
features.copy: Start from the goal instead: Start blank in the kickoff header opens the session straight on its Overview, and you add the goal, projects and work from there.

features.title: Pick up a task, with a drafted brief
features.copy: Turn an issue into a briefed session in one pick.

features.title: Ask an agent
features.copy: Map an unfamiliar repo before you plan: Scout is the default and can start with an empty prompt.

features.title: Run a workflow
features.copy: The full workflow builder, right in the kickoff: pick Orchestrated, Custom or Preset, see the plan you will run, edit the steps, choose which providers it can use, and set Starts, Autorun and a spend cap.

features.title: Named by Goodboy
features.copy: Get a short title without writing one.

features.title: Stage board
features.copy: See where each task stands without moving cards around.

features.title: Session card
features.copy: Read a task at a glance: pull request, issue and project chips, step progress, agent count, age and cost, plus one suggested action.

features.title: Done and Archived dock
features.copy: Keep finished work out of the way but close by.

features.title: Bulk select
features.copy: Tidy many sessions at once.

features.title: Now chip
features.copy: Know what needs you from any screen.

features.title: Session overview
features.copy: Find the goal, linked issues, projects, cost and the buttons to start an agent or a workflow on one screen.

features.title: Refresh a session
features.copy: See pull requests made outside Goodboy without reloading.

features.title: Activity
features.copy: Read the whole session as one timeline of agents, workflows, questions, fixes, artifacts, pull requests and decisions.

features.title: Next
features.copy: Know the one move that unblocks a task, like answering a question, fixing a failing check or opening a pull request.

features.title: Time left
features.copy: See how long a step has left, learned from your own past runs.

features.title: File versions
features.copy: Undo an agent's edit in a session without a branch: each file it changed is kept as it was, with Restore.

features.title: Worktrees
features.copy: Let agents edit in parallel without touching your checkout.

features.title: Several branches per project
features.copy: Work on several branches of one repo in the same session.

features.title: Roles
features.copy: Give each agent the job it is good at.

features.title: What the agent received
features.copy: Check exactly what an agent was told.

features.title: Agent transcript
features.copy: Follow one agent's work: grouped file edits, questions, permission cards and chips for the plans and reports it writes.

features.title: Queue or send now
features.copy: Keep talking while an agent works.

features.title: Stop and Continue
features.copy: Stop an agent without losing its work.

features.title: Turn footer
features.copy: See what each turn cost: provider, model, duration, tokens, cache share, estimated cost and a context meter.

features.title: Tool call states
features.copy: Tell at a glance what a tool call did: Running, Done, Failed, Needs approval, Stopped or Denied, with elapsed time and readable input and output.

features.title: Composer plus menu
features.copy: Do more from the message box: attach files, run a script ($), start a workflow (~) or ask another agent (@).

features.title: Attach files
features.copy: Hand an agent images, PDFs, CSV and text files, up to 10 at a time, by paste, drop or pick.

features.title: Drift warning
features.copy: Hear about it when an agent steps outside its role, like a planner editing files.

features.title: Subagents from plan parts
features.copy: Run a plan part by part.

features.title: History rewriter and Scribe
features.copy: Let two helpers work on your history and your pull request text without the power to push.

features.title: One language per session
features.copy: Get agents and summaries in the language of your goal.

features.title: Workflow builder
features.copy: Shape a run before it starts: a name, a goal and a mode, with the plan previewed as the tree the run will show.

features.title: Orchestrated
features.copy: Give a goal and let a model pick each next step, with its role, provider, model, effort and a reason, until it says done or blocked.

features.title: Hints to the orchestrator
features.copy: Steer a run while it goes.

features.title: Why each step, and the run recap
features.copy: See why each step was picked, and a short recap of what is done and what is left, rewritten after each decision.

features.title: Preset and Custom
features.copy: Write the steps yourself, press Draft with planner, or start from a saved workflow.

features.title: Built-in workflows
features.copy: Start from Refactor, Plan and ship or Fix a bug.

features.title: Saved steps
features.copy: Reuse steps across workflows.

features.title: Model per step
features.copy: Put a light model on a scout and a strong one on the planner.

features.title: Autorun
features.copy: Let a run move to its next step without you, per run or for the whole session.

features.title: Spend limit
features.copy: Cap what a run or a session can spend, and choose Pause workflows or Only warn me.

features.title: Chained starts
features.copy: Line work up behind work: start a run now, by hand, or after another run finishes.

features.title: Workflow run
features.copy: Follow a run as a tree with one pinned next action, and add steps to a live or finished run.

features.title: Step handoff summary
features.copy: Start each step from a short brief instead of the whole previous chat.

features.title: Open questions
features.copy: Get questions as cards instead of lines buried in a chat.

features.title: Let an agent answer
features.copy: Hand a question to another agent with a hint and a model, and its answer counts as yours.

features.title: Import workflows
features.copy: Bring custom workflows over from your other workspaces.

features.title: Decisions
features.copy: Record a decision once and have the agents after it read it.

features.title: See why each decision was made
features.copy: Read the reason behind a decision without opening the run.

features.title: Running summary
features.copy: Hand the next agent where things stand.

features.title: Context drawer
features.copy: Open goal, decisions and summary from any session page, with Copy as brief.

features.title: Context budgets
features.copy: Keep prompts small as a session grows.

features.title: Plans handed to the next agent
features.copy: Hand a plan straight to the implementer.

features.title: Supported tools
features.copy: Connect the ones you use.

features.title: Agents use your tools
features.copy: Let agents on any provider read and act on GitHub, GitLab, Bitbucket, Jira, Linear, Sentry and Slack, as far as you connected them, without handing them your keys.

features.title: Inbox
features.copy: Work from one list instead of seven tabs: issues, Slack threads and Sentry errors from your connected tools, plus pull requests from GitHub (review requests and your own recent ones) and merge requests from GitLab and Bitbucket, grouped by day, with keyboard navigation.

features.title: Find any issue by code or link
features.copy: Paste HBL-412, #318 or a link and open the issue, even when it is not assigned to you.

features.title: Starred issues
features.copy: Keep the issues you follow on top of the Inbox and of Pick up a task.

features.title: Launch a session from any item
features.copy: Start a session from an issue, a Slack thread or an error, with the brief already drafted.

features.title: Link an item to a session
features.copy: Attach an inbox item to work that already exists.

features.title: Trackers
features.copy: Comment, assign, edit and move issues in Linear and Jira, and read Sentry errors with stack trace and breadcrumbs, inside Goodboy.

features.title: Code hosts
features.copy: Work on GitHub pull requests and issues, GitLab merge requests, and Bitbucket comments, approvals and merges without leaving Goodboy.

features.title: Slack: what agents can do
features.copy: Decide how far agents go in Slack: pick the channels, then whether they read threads, reply and react.

features.title: Reply ready for #channel
features.copy: Approve what goes out in Slack from where you already are.

features.title: Slack signature
features.copy: Let people in a thread see when an agent wrote a reply.

features.title: Images from your tools
features.copy: See screenshots attached in Linear, Jira and GitHub inside Goodboy.

features.title: Records read the same way
features.copy: Read items from any tool the same way: one list of labels and values, with who opened them and when.

features.title: Comment threads
features.copy: Follow replies under the comment they answer, in Linear and GitLab, and Reply into that thread.

features.title: Artifacts
features.copy: Keep plans, reports and wireframes next to the task instead of in a chat, with who made each one and what it was built from.

features.title: Plan parts and Run plan
features.copy: Check a plan before it runs.

features.title: Report as a document
features.copy: Read a report as one document with an outline, and open the same file in a browser on another machine.

features.title: Files on disk
features.copy: Open any artifact as a folder, in your browser or your file manager.

features.title: Wireframes scouted first
features.copy: Get wireframes that start from your code.

features.title: Wireframe versions
features.copy: Go back to any wireframe version with View, Compare and Restore.

features.title: Compare
features.copy: See what changed between two wireframe versions side by side, with a change list that lights up each element in both frames.

features.title: Ask for a change
features.copy: Point at what you want changed: pick elements on the wireframe, choose this screen or all screens, and ask.

features.title: Import wireframe JSON
features.copy: Bring in a wireframe made elsewhere, with a preview of any fixes before it lands.

features.title: Revisions and Restore
features.copy: Bring back an earlier plan, report or wireframe as a new revision, with its author, without losing the later ones.

features.title: Save a copy and New variant
features.copy: Export a wireframe as a folder of pages, or redraw it at the other fidelity.

features.title: Resolve
features.copy: Turn review comments into commits without writing the fix yourself.

features.title: Comment states
features.copy: Know what each comment needs next.

features.title: Close on GitHub
features.copy: Finish a review in one action: Push N in the Review header pushes the fixes, posts the replies and resolves the threads, after a confirm right under the header.

features.title: Review replies in your voice
features.copy: Get replies that sound like you, Terse, Friendly, Formal or Like my replies.

features.title: Fixes on a branch that moved
features.copy: Accept a fix even after the branch got new commits: it lands on top of the latest one, and on a conflict the branch goes back to its old head.

features.title: Notes before a pull request
features.copy: Review your own diff before anyone else does.

features.title: GitHub pull request page
features.copy: Know whether a GitHub pull request can merge, in plain words, with details and checks, and merge, mark ready, draft or close it from there.

features.title: Pull request, Diff and Review as layers
features.copy: Move between a pull request, its Diff and its Review without losing your place.

features.title: Write it for me
features.copy: Get a pull request title, description and changelog entry in your repo's format when you open a pull request.

features.title: PR description follows the push
features.copy: Keep a pull request description in step with its branch.

features.title: Diff
features.copy: Read changes with syntax colors, word-level highlights, split or unified view and a Viewed tick per file, and quote a line into a note or a question for an agent.

features.title: Write review
features.copy: Review someone else's pull request in a form under the diff: your line comments, the verdict and a summary, sent with Approve, Request changes or Submit comments.

features.title: Rewrite history
features.copy: Clean up a branch by hand: drag a commit between two others to move it, drop it onto another to fold it in, rename, squash or remove it, or start the branch from today's main.

features.title: Safe apply
features.copy: Apply tries the whole plan on a temporary copy first and checks the result before your branch moves.

features.title: Conflict prediction
features.copy: See which files would conflict while you edit the plan, or read "No conflicts expected".

features.title: Conflicts merged in a copy
features.copy: Let the History rewriter merge a conflicting rewrite in a copy, and have Goodboy check the result before anything moves.

features.title: Push with lease and restore
features.copy: Apply and update online replaces the online branch only when nothing newer is there, so a teammate's push is never overwritten.

features.title: Suggest a message
features.copy: Get a commit message drafted for a squash or a reword.

features.title: Bring them into the plan
features.copy: Someone pushed after you applied?

features.title: Rebase on main
features.copy: Rebase on main with the same engine, and bring in an agent only when there is a conflict.

features.title: After a pull request merges
features.copy: Decide what happens to a merged branch, Ask me, Delete on this Mac or Also on origin, per workspace or project, with 14 days to restore it.

features.title: Usage limits chip
features.copy: See how much of your Claude and Codex plans is left before a run stops.

features.title: Use reset
features.copy: Spend a free Codex reset at the right moment.

features.title: Fallback when a limit is hit
features.copy: Keep a task moving when a provider runs out.

features.title: Fallback order and Auto
features.copy: Choose where Auto starts and the order it falls back through, with an Auto model for each role.

features.title: Model picker
features.copy: Pick a model with the reason next to it: Auto, a suggested model with its price ratio, the last one used, and family and effort chips.

features.title: Impact
features.copy: See what Goodboy got done and what it cost over 7 days, 30 days or all time, opening on one sentence built from your numbers.

features.title: Monthly cap and budget alert
features.copy: Set a monthly cap per provider and hear about it before you reach it.

features.title: Worktree folders
features.copy: Free disk space without guessing: worktree folders by repo, with their size, why each exists and whether it is safe to remove.

features.title: Branches
features.copy: Delete old branches with confidence.

features.title: Storage scope
features.copy: Clean up this workspace, other workspaces, removed ones or all of them, each with its weight, from the picker in the page header.

features.title: Free space chip
features.copy: See reclaimable space at a glance.

features.title: Artifacts from deleted sessions
features.copy: Decide what to keep from sessions you deleted: their plans, reports and wireframes, with Keep or Delete.

features.title: Goodboy can free N GB
features.copy: Hear about reclaimable space once, when idle safe folders pass 10 GB or the disk runs low.

features.title: Security findings
features.copy: Catch a token pasted into a saved script before it travels.

features.title: Findings kept out of the export
features.copy: Move your setup to a new machine without carrying a flagged token: an export leaves out the script that holds it, unless you include it on purpose.

features.title: Export and import your setup
features.copy: Move workspaces, projects, workflows, scripts, rules and preferences to another machine, in groups.

features.title: Backup before a data update
features.copy: Update without worrying about your data.

features.title: Newer data guard
features.copy: Open an older Goodboy on newer data without damage: it stops and offers Restore backup or Quit.

features.title: Updates
features.copy: Get updates in the background, then see what is new.

features.title: Changelog in the app
features.copy: Read release notes inside the app, searchable, with links into the screen each change touched.

features.title: Before and after pictures
features.copy: See a change instead of reading about it.

features.title: Report a bug
features.copy: Tell us what broke in one line.

features.title: Guide
features.copy: Learn how Goodboy works in 18 short chapters that follow a task, with search and links that open each screen.

features.title: Right click menus
features.copy: Right click a session, agent, run, artifact, pull request, worktree row, diff file or message to see every action it has, at the pointer.

features.title: Command palette
features.copy: Press ⌘K to act on what you are looking at: the verbs of the open session or agent come first, and → shows every action of any row.

features.title: Search
features.copy: Find a message, a plan, a decision, an issue or a branch with ⌘F, across every session, filtered by type, project, provider, status or date.

features.title: Terminal
features.copy: Open a real login shell in the session's worktree with ⌘T, and find it still there after a reload.

features.title: Keyboard shortcuts, back and forward
features.copy: Drive Goodboy from the keyboard: about 40 shortcuts, a key for each view, workspaces 1 to 9, and ⌘[ and ⌘] through history.

features.title: Notifications
features.copy: Catch up in one place: a bell with an unread count, and a page filtered by severity and source.

features.title: Script drawer
features.copy: Watch a script's live output with Stop, Run again and the exit code, and pick it back up after a reload.

features.title: Open in editor
features.copy: Jump into VS Code, Cursor, Zed, the JetBrains IDEs, Sublime Text, Vim or Neovim, at the worktree or the file.

features.title: Explore
features.copy: Browse the session folder as a file tree with previews, and Ask an agent about this file.

features.title: Written by Goodboy
features.copy: Comments Goodboy posts end with a line that says so, and a setting turns it off

features.title: Resolve again
features.copy: Rereads a comment and tries the fix once more

features.title: Checks
features.copy: The pull request's checks with durations, and a failed one becomes a Next suggestion

features.title: Settings rail
features.copy: Each settings area says what needs you, like folders not found

features.title: Update pill
features.copy: A single light sweep when an update is ready
